svg.title: From the car to the rear drive
svg.desc: The 2010 2.9 has its engine behind the seats, a transaxle extending rearwards and a short CV shaft to each rear hub. The gearbox drives the differential, then two jointed shafts turn the rear hubs. A forward engine mount and two transmission supports connect the joined power unit to the body. Numbered parts: 1 Engine; 2 Front engine mount; 3 Gearbox and mounts; 4 Open differential; 5 Left CV shaft; 6 Right CV shaft; 7 Left hub and carrier; 8 Right hub and carrier. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
